items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: And he liked the way I played the accompaniment on the guitar. And he used to have a jam session at his house with the mandolin.

ctx.x: Willie San Diego was. He was a good bandoliner. He used to have a jam session. It's the only time he got to play the mandolin, you see? Oh, yeah.
And he liked the way I played the accompaniment on the guitar. And he used to have a jam session at his house with the mandolin. That's when you live downtown, too.
